name: New Relationships
overview: Scripture teaches that new relationships in Christ transcend earthly divisions, uniting believers as one body regardless of background or status, as Galatians 3:28 affirms. Trusting fully in the Lord rather than our own understanding (Proverbs 3:5) is foundational to building these relationships. Believers are called to speak with grace that edifies (Ephesians 4:29) and to embody kindness, tenderheartedness, and forgiveness toward one another, reflecting the forgiveness granted through Christ (Ephesians 4:32; Colossians 3:13). These principles guide Christians in forming and sustaining godly, Christ-centered relationships.
